post.summary: Adds a library and starts its first scan.

delete.summary: Removes a library from batvision (files on disk are never touched).

get.summary: Searches TMDB, to pick the right match for a misidentified item.

post.summary: Pins a movie to a TMDB id. Later scans never override a manual identification.
Pins a series to a TMDB id and refetches its seasons and episodes.
Creates an account from an invitation link and signs the device in.
Approves the code shown on another device, signing it in as the caller.

get.summary: Liveness check used by Docker and the reverse proxy.
TMDB image (poster, backdrop, still), cached on disk. Public, so it works in `` tags; only images referenced by the library are served.

delete.summary: Signs a device out. Its token stops working immediately.

put.summary: Changes the password and signs out every other device.

post.summary: Disables 2FA. Not allowed for administrators, for whom it is mandatory.
Replaces all recovery codes (for example after using several of them).
Starts 2FA enrollment. 2FA becomes active only after `/api/me/totp/enable`.
Creates the first administrator. They must then enable 2FA before using admin features.

get.summary: Server version and detected ffmpeg capabilities (admins only).

language.description: ISO 639-2 code as tagged in the file (`fre`, `eng`…), if any.

path.description: Folder relative to the media root, e.g. `Films`.

DeviceInfo.description: What a client says about itself when signing in.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the device list ("Pixel 9", "Firefox – Mac").

ErrorBody.description:
Error body returned by every endpoint. `code` is stable and meant for clients;
`message` is for humans and logs.

version.description: First line of `ffmpeg -version`, or `None` if ffmpeg could not be run.

working_encoders.description: Encoders that completed a test encode.

oneOf.description: `None` until the file has been analyzed (or if analysis failed).

token.description: Shown only once. The client builds the invitation link from it.

oneOf.description: Password accepted; send a TOTP or recovery code to `/api/auth/login/totp`.
Not approved yet: poll again in a few seconds.

code.description: Show this on screen; the user types it on a signed-in device.

codes.description: Shown only once. Each code can be used once instead of a TOTP code.

metadata_skipped.description: Why metadata was skipped, if it was (no TMDB token…).

newly_missing.description: Items not found anymore (hidden until their files come back).

Session.description: Returned when a device is signed in. The token is shown only once.

setup_token.description: Printed in the server logs at startup while no account exists.

needed.description: True while no account exists: the first admin must be created with the setup token.

text.description: Text subtitles can be converted for the client; image ones must be burned in.

oneOf.description: `None` while the startup probe is still running.

code.description: Current code from the authenticator app, proving it was set up correctly.
6-digit code from the authenticator app, or a recovery code.

otpauth_url.description: `otpauth://` URL, to display as a QR code.

TrackKind.description: What a track is for, used to carry a track choice from one episode to the next.

hdr.description: HDR10/HLG/Dolby Vision, detected from the transfer characteristics.
